violated_contract: Server recovery must never turn a hidden row with nothing a person could want back (empty transcript, filler, mic check) into a visible completed conversation; it must reach the same relevance verdict capture-end processing would, recorded as an explicit, restorable server-recovery discard.
canonical_prevention: At the recovery rule-skip point, emit a server-recovery RelevanceDecision for a clear ordinary rule discard and return discarded=True so the explicit-discard terminal path persists it; only ambiguous or kept content may reach the visible minimum terminal.
